title: A machine-checked bound of 0.6934 for Besicovitch's 1/2-problem
abstract: Proves the planar Besicovitch threshold is at most 6934/10000, improving the published 7/10 record. The development formalizes the finite six-point reduction, thirty rational Gram certificates, the endpoint isolation argument, and Besicovitch's classical lower-bound example.

informal.LeanPool.Besicovitch.sigmaOne_plane_le_b: The planar one-dimensional rectifiability threshold is at most 6934/10000, improving the published upper bound 7/10.
informal.LeanPool.Besicovitch.forcesOneRectifiabi: Every threshold strictly above 6934/10000 forces countable one-rectifiability in the plane.
informal.LeanPool.Besicovitch.Example.one_half_le: The planar threshold is at least one half, witnessed by Besicovitch's purely unrectifiable example.
informal.LeanPool.Besicovitch.weightedPairScore_l: Thirty exact rational Gram certificates prove the weighted six-point score is at most -1/2000 for every separated admissible pair in the unit ball.
